name: patbridnoaria
description: Real-Debrid blackhole downloader without the need for aria2 Downloads torrent and magnet files via real-debrid.com and puts them into dowanload_dir. Protects your privacy and saves you bandwidth. Real-Debrid.com account required. I am not affiliated with real-debrid and I offer no warranties. https://hub.docker.com/r/datpat/patbridnoaria/ REAL_DEBRID_API_KEY, WATCH_DIR = '/watch', DOWNLOAD_DIR = '/download', WATCH_RATE = 5000

paths.name: DOWNLOAD_DIR
paths.description: where should the files be downloaded to?

paths.name: WATCH_DIR
paths.description: Where sonarr and radarr put the torrent and magnet files

variables.name: WATCH_RATE
variables.description: how frequently should the folders be checked for new torrent or magnet files?
